mapper.select: SELECT t.stage_no AS stageNo, t.stage AS stage, t.n AS customers, ROUND(t.n * 1.0 / NULLIF(LAG(t.n) OVER (ORDER BY t.stage_no), 0), 4) AS convPrev, ROUND(t.n * 1.0 / NULLIF(FIRST_VALUE(t.n) OVER (ORDER BY t.stage_no), 0), 4) AS convTotal FROM ( SELECT m.stage_no, m.stage, CASE m.stage_no WHEN 1 THEN s.n1 WHEN 2 THEN s.n2 WHEN 3 THEN s.n3 WHEN 4 THEN s.n4 WHEN 5 THEN s.n5 ELSE s.n6 END AS n FROM ( SELECT 1 AS stage_no, '웹 가입' AS stage UNION ALL SELECT 2, '마이데이터 동의' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '계좌 신청' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '개설' UNION ALL SELECT 5, '첫 매도' UNION ALL SELECT 6, '첫 국내 매수' ) m CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS n1, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n2, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n3, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.opened_at < #{clockDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n4, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.opened_at < #{clockDate} AND so.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n5, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND a.opened_at < #{clockDate} AND so.account_id IS NOT NULL AND bo.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n6 FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_consent WHERE consent_type = 'MYDATA_PROVISION' AND agreed AND changed_at < #{clockDate} ) k ON k.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN account a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id AND a.created_at < #{clockDate} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM sell_order WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} ) so ON so.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'BUY' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} ) bo ON bo.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.created_at < #{clockDate} ) s ) t ORDER BY t.stage_no

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE opened_at IS NOT NULL AND opened_at < #{clockDate}) AS openedAccounts, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(final_amount) FROM krw_exchange WHERE settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND final_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS inflowTotal, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(amount) - fee_amount) FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'BUY' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticBuyTotal, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount + fee_amount + tax_amount) FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'SELL' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticSellTotal

SELECT cls.code AS code, COUNT(*) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN cls.external_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withExternalBuy FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN t.weighted_sell = 0 THEN 'NO_SELL' WHEN a.benefit = 'IMPOSSIBLE' THEN 'BENEFIT_CANCELED' WHEN t.adjust_ratio = 1 THEN 'NO_IMPACT' WHEN t.adjust_ratio > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL_REDUCED' ELSE 'EXTERNAL_BUY_OFFSET' END AS code, t.weighted_external_amount AS external_amount FROM tax_snapshot t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id ) cls GROUP BY cls.code

SELECT flow_month AS flowMonth, SUM(foreign_sell_amount) AS foreignSellAmount, SUM(krw_inflow_amount) AS krwInflowAmount, SUM(domestic_buy_amount) AS domesticBuyAmount, SUM(domestic_sell_amount) AS domesticSellAmount, SUM(withdrawal_amount) AS withdrawalAmount, SUM(cash_balance_begin) AS cashBalanceBegin, SUM(cash_balance_end) AS cashBalanceEnd FROM fund_flow_monthly WHERE flow_month < #{monthStart} AND flow_month >= #{fromMonth} AND flow_month <= #{toMonth} GROUP BY flow_month ORDER BY flow_month

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(sell_qty * base_price) FROM sell_order WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS foreignSellAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(final_amount) FROM krw_exchange WHERE settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND final_at >= #{monthStart} AND final_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS krwInflowAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(amount)) FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'BUY' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticBuyAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM domestic_order WHERE side = 'SELL' AND status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticSellAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(requested_amount) FROM withdrawal WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND processed_at >= #{monthStart} AND processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS withdrawalAmount

SELECT p.age_band AS ageBand, p.investor_type AS investorType, COUNT(*) AS accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.inflow > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accountsWithInflow, SUM(p.inflow) AS inflowTotal, SUM(p.buy_exec) AS buyTotal, SUM(p.sell_exec) AS sellTotal FROM ( SELECT acc.investor_type, CASE WHEN acc.age < 30 THEN '20대 이하' WHEN acc.age < 40 THEN '30대' WHEN acc.age < 50 THEN '40대' WHEN acc.age < 60 THEN '50대' ELSE '60대 이상' END AS age_band, COALESCE(i.inflow, 0) AS inflow, COALESCE(d.buy_exec, 0) AS buy_exec, COALESCE(d.sell_exec, 0) AS sell_exec FROM ( SELECT a.account_id, c.investor_type, YEAR(#{asOfDate}) - YEAR(c.birth_date) - CASE WHEN MONTH(#{asOfDate}) * 100 + DAY(#{asOfDate}) < MONTH(c.birth_date) * 100 + DAY(c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.opened_at IS NOT NULL AND a.opened_at < #{clockDate} ) acc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, SUM(final_amount) AS inflow FROM krw_exchange WHERE settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND final_at < #{clockDate} GROUP BY account_id ) i ON i.account_id = acc.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN ABS(amount) - fee_amount ELSE 0 END) AS buy_exec, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'SELL' THEN amount + fee_amount + tax_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sell_exec FROM domestic_order WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} GROUP BY account_id ) d ON d.account_id = acc.account_id ) p GROUP BY p.age_band, p.investor_type ORDER BY p.age_band, p.investor_type

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts, COALESCE(SUM(r.general_tax), 0) AS generalTaxTotal, COALESCE(SUM(r.final_tax), 0) AS finalTaxTotal, COALESCE(SUM(r.general_tax - r.final_tax), 0) AS reliefTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.general_tax - r.final_tax > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS accountsWithRelief, COALESCE(SUM(r.net_invest), 0) AS netInvestTotal FROM ( SELECT t.final_tax AS final_tax, ROUND(rule.rate * GREATEST(0, t.original_gain_amount - rule.basic), 2) AS general_tax, COALESCE(d.net_invest, 0) AS net_invest FROM tax_snapshot t CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rule_type = 'BASIC_DEDUCTION' THEN rule_value END), 0) AS basic, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rule_type = 'TAX_RATE' THEN rule_value END), 0) AS rate FROM tax_rule WHERE valid_from <= #{asOfDate} AND valid_to >= #{asOfDate} ) rule LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN ABS(amount) - fee_amount ELSE -(amount + fee_amount + tax_amount) END) AS net_invest FROM domestic_order WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' AND processed_at < #{clockDate} GROUP BY account_id ) d ON d.account_id = t.account_id ) r
WHERE r.general_tax - r.final_tax > 0

SELECT p.name AS name, p.type AS type, p.sector_name AS sectorName, SUM(b.qty * b.avg_purchase_price) AS purchaseCost FROM domestic_stock_balance b JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = b.domestic_product_id WHERE b.qty > 0 GROUP BY p.domestic_product_id, p.name, p.type, p.sector_name

SELECT p.name AS name, p.type AS type, p.sector_name AS sectorName, SUM(b.qty * b.avg_purchase_price) AS purchaseCost FROM domestic_stock_balance b JOIN account a ON a.account_id = b.account_id JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = b.domestic_product_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.status = 'OPENED' AND b.qty > 0 GROUP BY p.domestic_product_id, p.name, p.type, p.sector_name

SELECT p.name AS name, p.type AS type, p.sector_name AS sectorName, SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN ABS(o.amount) - o.fee_amount ELSE -(o.amount + o.fee_amount + o.tax_amount) END) AS netBuyExec FROM domestic_order o JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id = o.domestic_product_id WHERE o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate} GROUP BY p.domestic_product_id, p.name, p.type, p.sector_name ORDER BY netBuyExec DESC, p.domestic_product_id LIMIT 10

SELECT TRUE AS hasAccount, a.amount AS cashBalance, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.sell_qty * s.base_price) FROM sell_order s WHERE s.account_id = a.account_id AND s.status = 'EXECUTED' AND s.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS soldForeignAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(k.final_amount) FROM krw_exchange k WHERE k.account_id = a.account_id AND k.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND k.final_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS krwInflowAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(o.amount) - o.fee_amount) FROM domestic_order o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.side = 'BUY' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticBuyAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.fee_amount) FROM domestic_order o WHERE o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.side = 'BUY' AND o.status = 'EXECUTED' AND o.processed_at < #{clockDate}), 0) AS domesticBuyFeeAmount FROM account a WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT f.flow_month AS flowMonth, f.foreign_sell_amount AS foreignSellAmount, f.krw_inflow_amount AS krwInflowAmount, f.domestic_buy_amount AS domesticBuyAmount, f.domestic_sell_amount AS domesticSellAmount, f.withdrawal_amount AS withdrawalAmount, f.cash_balance_begin AS cashBalanceBegin, f.cash_balance_end AS cashBalanceEnd FROM fund_flow_monthly f JOIN account a ON a.account_id = f.account_id WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY f.flow_month

SELECT TRUE AS hasAccount, a.benefit AS benefit, t.weighted_sell AS weightedSell, t.adjust_ratio AS adjustRatio, t.final_deduction AS finalDeduction, t.final_tax AS finalTax, t.calculated_at AS calculatedAt, ROUND(rule.rate * GREATEST(0, t.original_gain_amount - rule.basic), 2) AS generalTax FROM account a LEFT JOIN tax_snapshot t ON t.account_id = a.account_id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rule_type = 'BASIC_DEDUCTION' THEN rule_value END), 0) AS basic, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rule_type = 'TAX_RATE' THEN rule_value END), 0) AS rate FROM tax_rule WHERE valid_from <= #{asOfDate} AND valid_to >= #{asOfDate} ) rule WHERE a.customer_id = #{customerId} AND a.opened_at IS NOT NULL
